astra_source_review.reason: This is an explicit assessment of AI's major effects on human welfare, not a single application. He expects accelerated growth and reduced need for human labor to be beneficial on balance, while treating changes to the values shaping the future as probably negative and more important over the long run. The latter risk is also more speculative and potentially preventable through coordination. This supports a mixed assessment, not unqualified optimism or a claim that harms will necessarily dominate. It is a historical, humanity-wide view rather than an America-specific or current statement.
